description: Ministry of Highways & Road Development and Petroleum Resources Development - Declare, Outer Circular Highway to be an Expressway
categorisation: This gazette content is a legal order made under Section 9 of The National Thoroughfares Act, No. 40 of 2008. It designates a specific highway section as an Expressway and rescinds a previous order. The content is primarily about regulatory action and the exercise of statutory powers, fitting the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) which include "statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation" and "regulatory frameworks." While a minister's name is mentioned, this is in the context of executing a legal function, not detailing government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities.
